help.zh-CN: 复杂项目（如 eVTOL）：默认 3 轮。

help.en: 1 to 5. Usually 2; 3 for a complex project.
help.zh-CN: 1 至 5 轮。通常 2 轮；复杂项目 3 轮。

help.en: Default for new lines. Totals stay per currency, never converted.
help.zh-CN: 新行默认货币。合计按货币分开，不换算。

help.en: % on top of the subtotal, per currency.
help.zh-CN: 按货币在小计上加的百分比。

help.en: Motors built in this iteration (2 for a back-to-back dyno).
help.zh-CN: 本轮制造的电机数（背靠背测功机为 2 台）。

help.en: None = no testing in this iteration.
Iteration 1: the tooling. Later: modifications, % of iteration 1 or an amount.
help.zh-CN: 第 1 轮：工装。之后：修改，按第 1 轮的百分比或金额。

help.en: Cost of one motor; multiplied by the motors of the iteration.
help.zh-CN: 单台电机成本；乘以本轮电机数。

help.en: One amount for the bench work of this iteration.
help.zh-CN: 本轮台架测试的总金额。

help.en: One amount for the shipments of this iteration.
